name: Muhl Product & Service Aktiengesellschaft
summary: Mühl Product & Service Aktiengesellschaft, through its subsidiaries, supplies construction materials. The company is based in Kranichfeld, Germany. Mühl Product & Service Aktiengesellschaft was formerly a subsidiary of Mühl24 GmbH. As of June 10, 2016, Mühl Product & Service Aktiengesellschaft is in liquidation.
